paragraphs.text: The gentle incline is misleading, and your forehead is damp by the time you reach the top of the hill. You pause for a moment to get your breath back, and look east. The valley ahead is thick with forest, although you catch glimpses of a narrow waterway. There is still no sign of a settlement. That might be something on the horizon—a spire, maybe? But it is surely another eight or nine hours’ walk.
You look back at Emberhead. The hilltop village is black, a rough silhouette against the shimmering orb of sunset.
You may make an Archaeology roll. If you succeed, go to 66. Otherwise, go to 72.
